manifesto_title: An “event” is anything that has to happen on time.
manifesto_text:
A launch. A candidate forum. A Derby party on the water. A statewide sampling program. A press release that has to land tonight. A situation that's going sideways and needs someone to take the wheel.

I named the company Manage the Event because the job is always the same: figure out what done looks like, build the structure to get there, and run it until it's finished.

services_intro: Four kinds of work, one way of doing it.

services.title: Events and production
services.text: Concept, branding, run of show, vendors, sponsors, staffing, and the night itself. Fundraisers, signature community events, civic forums, and VIP hospitality.
points: Run of show and stage management

services.title: Campaign operations
services.text: The infrastructure behind a campaign, so the candidate can campaign: fundraising operations, volunteers, events, messaging calendars, and the tools that tie them together.

services.title: Field programs and brand activations
services.text: Statewide and national programs for spirits and consumer brands, with every visit tracked: talent booking, routes, store recaps, photos, and live client reporting.

services.title: Systems, tools, and reporting
services.text: Custom Airtable builds and simple websites that make the work run itself, plus recap executive summaries clients actually read.
points: Airtable with Twilio, SendGrid, Front, MiniExtensions, and APIs
Websites with an easy editor for non-technical teams

process.title: Define done
process.text: What has to be true when it's over: the turnout, the budget, the result, the story you want to tell.

process.title: Build the system
process.text: Timeline, team, tools, and tracking, set up before the rush so nothing lives in someone's head.

process.title: Run it
process.text: On site or across 20 states. Clear owners, fast decisions, and someone watching every detail.

process.title: Report back
process.text: Clean recaps, real numbers, and what to do next time, ready to hand to your boss, board, or client.

roles.text: Event management and operational consulting for organizations across Tampa Bay and nationwide.
